objective: Remove the vendored frontend-design skill from HolyAgent and carry its directives in HolyAgent's own design skills, released as 0.2.2.
requirements: Maintainer request (verbatim): "hey frontend design is still on the codebase, please remove it. make sure its directives are in other skill(s)" and "that must be 0.2.2".

Remove frontend-design everywhere it is vendored, embedded, generated, licensed, tested or documented: packages/integrations/claude/vendor/frontend-design, the worker-visual and reviewer-visual frontend-design.md role sections, dist/licenses/frontend-design, the generator code in packages/integrations/claude/src, tests, README and docs.

Every directive frontend-design gives must be present in HolyAgent's own skills afterwards (the shared design core and web-design, or the platform skill it fits), in HolyAgent's own words and structure, without duplicating what those skills already say; the visual agents load or name those skills instead of the removed section.

Credit and licensing follow frontend-design's license: if carrying its directives over requires a notice, keep that notice and the attribution in docs/attributions.md; otherwise keep it credited as an inspiration in the README's Special thanks.
Do not change .claude/CLAUDE.md; keep the README's fixed section structure; follow .claude/CLAUDE.md code rules (JSDoc, Effect, skill descriptions start with the situation).

Release model (repository convention): release/0.2.2/integration cut from main; one release/0.2.2/<type>/<change> branch and PR per reviewable change into it, the first PR carrying the bump to 0.2.2 made with mise run bump:patch as its own commit; then an integration to main PR.
Done means mise run verify passes with the build in sync and CI green on every PR including Windows.
Default (maintainer's standing instruction from 0.2.1, "merge whenever merge ready"): the root squash-merges each reviewed, green PR, the integration to main PR included, once it is merge-ready.
